name: pulse
description: Local-first analytics for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Command Code and Orion App, with Discord Rich Presence.

scripts.lint: oxlint frontend/src tests/components tests/unit tests/integration tests/setup.ts tests/bun-setup.ts
scripts.fmt: bun fmt --no-script frontend tests/components tests/unit tests/integration tests/setup.ts tests/bun-setup.ts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json && cargo fmt --all
scripts.fmt:check: bun fmt --no-script --check frontend tests/components tests/unit tests/integration tests/setup.ts tests/bun-setup.ts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json && cargo fmt --all -- --check
